newsitem.title: USA: California Micro holder wants CEO replaced.
newsitem.headline: California Micro holder wants CEO replaced.

text.p: Clover Capital Management Inc, a large shareholder in California Microwave Inc, said it recommended that the company's chief executive officer, Phillip Otto, be replaced.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday, Clover said it made the recommendation in a meeting with Otto and Dennis Raney, the company's chief financial officer, on August 28.

Clover said California Microwave's credibility in the investment community had suffered because Otto's earnings forecasts have failed to materialize. In addition, it said the company's performance "has been and continues to be inferior to the company's competitors."

Clover, which holds a 7.7 percent stake in California Microwave, said that in future, it may present specific business strategies or provide the company with advice on ways to maximize shareholder value.
California Microwave, based in Redwood City, Calif., supplies microwave radios and other telecommunications products to satellite systems.
